cases.sentence: Разве вы не знаете, что ___ Галаадский принадлежит нам?
cases.translation: Don't you know Ramoth Gilead belongs to us?
cases.explain: The subject of "принадлежит" (belongs) requires the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Пойдешь ли ты воевать за ___ Галаадский?
cases.translation: Will you go to battle for Ramoth Gilead?
cases.explain: The preposition "за" (for) with the sense of purpose uses the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Мой народ твой народ, мои кони твои ___.
cases.translation: My people are your people, my horses are your horses.
cases.explain: The predicate nominative requires the nominative case.
The preposition "у" (from, with) always governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: He gathered about four hundred prophets.
cases.explain: Numbers require the genitive case for counted nouns.

cases.sentence: Все остальные ___ пророчествовали о том же.
cases.translation: All the other prophets prophesied the same thing.
cases.explain: The subject of "пророчествовали" requires the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Я видел Господа, сидящим на своем ___, со всем небесным воинством.
cases.translation: I saw the Lord sitting on His throne with all the heavenly host.
cases.explain: The preposition "на" with location (sitting on) uses the prepositional case.

cases.translation: One spirit suggested one thing, another suggested another.
cases.explain: The elliptical construction implies a partitive or comparative genitive.

reading.ru: Три года между Арамом и Израилем не было войны.
reading.question: How long was there peace?
reading.explain: The text explicitly states there was no war between Syria and Israel for three years.

reading.ru: Разве вы не знаете, что Рамот Галаадский принадлежит нам, а мы и не пытаемся забрать его?
reading.question: What was Ahab's claim?
options: Ramoth Gilead belonged to Israel but they had not tried to take it
It was a neutral city between kingdoms
It belonged to Syria and must be respected
It was worthless and not worth fighting for
reading.correct: Ramoth Gilead belonged to Israel but they had not tried to take it
reading.explain: Ahab acknowledged that Ramoth Gilead was theirs but that they had not attempted to reclaim it.

reading.ru: Но Иосафат спросил, «Разве нет здесь еще пророка Господа, которого мы могли бы спросить?»
reading.question: Why did Jehoshaphat want another prophet?
options: He wanted to seek God's true counsel through His prophet
He was afraid of making mistakes
reading.correct: He wanted to seek God's true counsel through His prophet
reading.explain: Jehoshaphat wanted to inquire of the Lord's prophet, showing desire for God's true guidance.

reading.ru: Я видел весь Израиль рассеянным по горам, как овцы без пастуха.
reading.question: What was Micaiah's vision?
options: Israel scattered like sheep without a shepherd
reading.correct: Israel scattered like sheep without a shepherd
reading.explain: Micaiah prophesied that he saw Israel scattered upon the mountains as sheep without a shepherd.

reading.ru: Я видел Господа, сидящим на своем престоле, со всем небесным воинством, стоявшим справа и слева от него.
reading.question: What did Micaiah see in his vision?
options: The Lord on His throne with the heavenly army standing beside Him
reading.correct: The Lord on His throne with the heavenly army standing beside Him
reading.explain: Micaiah saw the Lord sitting on His throne with all the host of heaven standing by Him.

reading.ru: Как этот дух Господа перешел от меня к тебе, чтобы говорить с тобой?
reading.question: What was Zedekiah's reaction to Micaiah?
options: He asked which way the Spirit of God had left him for Micaiah
He offered to surrender to Micaiah
He asked Micaiah to teach him
reading.correct: He asked which way the Spirit of God had left him for Micaiah
reading.explain: Zedekiah struck Micaiah and sarcastically asked which way the Spirit of the Lord had gone from him to speak to Micaiah.
